subject: Every string the arrange.menus surface exposes to AX in de-DE
question: What labels does Logic show on arrange.menus in de-DE, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in de-DE whose arrange.menus rows carry the same 606 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file; rows were assigned to this surface by what their path or help text passes through, and rows no rule could place are counted in limits rather than filed.

strings: 1 Automationspunkt jeweils für Lautstärke, Panorama und Sends erstellen
2 Automationspunkte jeweils für Lautstärke, Panorama und Sends erstellen
Alle Automationsdaten der ausgewählten Spuren löschen
Alle folgenden Objekte in derselben Spur
Gerundete Locator-Punkte an Auswahl anpassen und Cycle aktivieren
Konvertiert alle Daten der Regionsautomation in Spurautomation
Konvertiert alle Daten der Spurautomation in Regionsautomation
Konvertiert sichtbare Daten der Regionsautomation in Spurautomation
Konvertiert sichtbare Daten der Spurautomation in Regionsautomation
Locator-Punkte an Auswahl anpassen und Cycle aktivieren
Locator-Punkte um die Cycle-Länge rückwärts bewegen
Projekt an Final Cut Pro XML …
Projekttempo auf Regionstempo und Downbeat anwenden
Sichtbare Automationsdaten der ausgewählten Spuren löschen
Tempo der Regionslänge und den Locator-Punkten anpassen
Verwaiste Automationsdaten der ausgewählten Spuren löschen
Weitere Infos zu Apple Creator Studio …
Wiedergabe stoppen und zum linken Locator-Punkt gehen
Zwischen Cycle- und Projekt-Start wechseln, wenn gestoppt
Zwischen Marquee- und Projekt-Start wechseln, wenn gestoppt
Zwischen ausgewähltem Regions- und Projektstart wechseln, wenn gestoppt
Zwischen letzter Locator-Position und Projekt-Start wechseln, wenn gestoppt

conclusion: On this host in de-DE, arrange.menus exposes 778 elements carrying 606 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.
207 window rows matched no surface rule and are not filed under any record; they are in the evidence file and can be re-classified when a rule exists.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.

2 strings are neither cited nor proved absent: each is absent from Apple's corpora as bytes and a shipped label folds to it (a colon, an ellipsis, a case), so the spelling Logic ships is not something this census read: 시스템 설정…; 최근 사용 항목
